notes: A stated tower defense: waves of spirits walk a lane, summoned units are placed and upgraded on ground flanking it, and the answers confirm the round ends when the core falls, which is what tracker-core is. Shape is lane-actor-track and its P6 stands — the lane must be one continuous valid route — with the short screen-filling lane from the answers, and choke-bottleneck kept since a compact lane wants a place where waves bunch. P4 is earned rather than assumed: the author was asked directly and chose four separate maps over four regions of one connected map, so the spiritual city, forest, castle and dimensional realm are four builds of this same shape dressed differently. The 34-unit rarity ladder, trading, quests, daily rewards, raids and summon animations are progression and presentation with no layout footprint, so they add no options and no second genre.
